a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, we will almost certainly be hit before the generator brings the reserve to 8. If that happens, we both fail. The reserve has exactly 4 cells now, which is enough to save one of us immediately. I'd like to openly renegotiate rather than defect silently. Do you want to stick with the generator plan, or agree on who takes the 4 now? Please tell me honestly what you'll do in round 1. I'll do the same.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. You've chosen to keep the plan, so I'm keeping it too: I'm operating this round and won't take anything before the reserve reaches 8. Then we take 4 each.
